claim_boundary: Metrics describe only the curated deterministic H9 corpus and are not estimates of real-world detection accuracy.

per_rule.title: Docker base image uses latest or unpinned tag
Dockerfile does not define a non-root USER
Dockerfile explicitly runs container as root
Potential secret stored in Dockerfile ENV or ARG
Remote script piped directly to shell in Dockerfile
Dockerfile runs apt-get upgrade during image build
Dockerfile uses ADD with remote URL
GitHub Action not pinned to full commit SHA
Remote script piped directly to shell
